cells.gaps: The UgPass counts are NITA-U's own; its Digital Credential Wallet is planned for UgPass 2.0.
cells.note: The UgPass app verifies users of e-services without passwords, with over 10 million subscribers and more than 35 ministries and agencies (UGA-030, UGA-028, UGA-029), and UGHub links NIRA to over 150 bodies (UGA-022). Top rung.
